description: Capture listeners of attribute bags (Svelte's on<event>capture, M6 overlays: bits-ui's dismissible layer), compared with Chromium: clicks run the capture listeners from the outer element down to the target before the target's and the bubbling listeners, stopPropagation in a capture listener ends the dispatch, focus and blur (which do not bubble) reach the ancestors' capture listeners, and a key's capture listener sees the key
